info.name: Vaulted Money Local API
info.description:
Test suite for the Vaulted Money desktop Local API (v1).

See documentation/postman/README.md for setup. Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner; the suite creates and then deletes its own throwaway ledger.

exec: // Dates used by request bodies and filters.

item.name: 00 Smoke and security

exec: pm.test("status is ok", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.status === "ok").to.be.true; });
pm.test("lists more than 40 routes", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.version === 'v1' && json.routes.length > 40).to.be.true; });

request.description: Overrides the collection auth with an invalid bearer token.
Requests with an Origin header are refused so web pages cannot drive the API.

item.description: Connectivity, authentication and the browser-origin guard.

request.description: Creates a throwaway ledger. Every later request is scoped to it, so your real ledgers are never touched.

exec: pm.test("contains the test ledger", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.some(l => l.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('ledgerId'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("renamed", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.name === 'Postman Test Ledger (renamed)').to.be.true; });
pm.test("error code", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.error.code === 'validation_error').to.be.true; });
pm.test("two accounts", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("balance equals starting balance", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.balance === 1000).to.be.true; });
pm.test("balance reflects new starting balance", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.balance === 1500).to.be.true; });
pm.test("no accounts in list", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.every(v => !v.is_account)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("accounts included", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.some(v => v.is_account)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("currency inherited from account", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.currency === 'USD').to.be.true; });
pm.test("three created", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.count === 3).to.be.true; });
pm.test("legs have opposite signs", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.outgoing.amount === -200 && json.incoming.amount === 200).to.be.true; });
pm.test("has total and page", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.total >= 7 && json.data.length <= 10 && json.limit === 10).to.be.true; });

pm.test("only that category", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.length >= 1 && json.data.every(t => t.category === pm.collectionVariables.get('categoryName') && t.amount < 0)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("two cafe transactions", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.total === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("no transfers", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.every(t => t.category !== 'Transfer')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("amount updated", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.amount === -45).to.be.true; });
pm.test("one schedule", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.length === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("amount updated", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.amount === -950).to.be.true; });
pm.test("spent amount computed", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(typeof json.spent_amount === 'number').to.be.true; });
pm.test("two budgets", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("target updated", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.target_amount === 150).to.be.true; });

item.name: 08 Currencies

exec: pm.test("has base and rates", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.currencies.length > 0 && json.currencies.every(c => c.rate !== undefined)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("code normalised", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.code === 'ZZZ').to.be.true; });
pm.test("rate updated", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.rate === 3).to.be.true; });

item.description: Only adds and removes a throwaway currency (ZZZ); your base currency and rates are untouched.

exec: pm.test("built-ins listed", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.available.some(l => l.code === 'es' && l.builtIn)).to.be.true; });

request.description: Sets the language to the one already active, so your preference is unchanged.

exec: pm.test("listed as custom", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.available.some(l => l.code === 'pmx' && !l.builtIn)).to.be.true; });

item.name: 10 AI providers

exec: pm.test("key reported but not returned", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.has_api_key === true).to.be.true; });
pm.test("model updated", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.model === 'llama3.1').to.be.true; });
pm.test("has_api_key false", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.has_api_key === false).to.be.true; });

item.description: Creates and removes a throwaway provider. Your default provider is not changed.

exec: pm.test("totals add up", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.totals.income === 3000 && json.totals.expenses > 0 && json.byCategory.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("budgets and trends", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json.budgets) && json.trends !== undefined).to.be.true; });
pm.test("totals", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.report === 'income-expense' && json.totalIncome === 3000).to.be.true; });
pm.test("assets reported", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.report === 'net-worth' && json.accounts.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("asks for confirm_replace", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.error.message.includes('confirm_replace')).to.be.true; });
const body = { content: pm.collectionVariables.get("encryptedBackup"), password: "wrong", ledger_id: pm.collectionVariables.get("ledgerId"), confirm_replace: true };
pm.request.body.update({ mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body), options: { raw: { language: "json" } } });

item.name: Restore test ledger from plain backup

request.description: Replaces ONLY the test ledger's data (ledger_id is set). Omitting ledger_id would replace everything.

exec: const body = { content: pm.collectionVariables.get("backupContent"), ledger_id: pm.collectionVariables.get("ledgerId"), confirm_replace: true, force: true };
pm.request.body.update({ mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body), options: { raw: { language: "json" } } });

item.name: Restore test ledger from encrypted backup

exec: const body = { content: pm.collectionVariables.get("encryptedBackup"), password: "postman-passphrase", ledger_id: pm.collectionVariables.get("ledgerId"), confirm_replace: true };
pm.request.body.update({ mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body), options: { raw: { language: "json" } } });
pm.test("transactions restored", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.total >= 4).to.be.true; });

request.description: Removes the throwaway ledger and everything in it. The app reloads its UI afterwards.
